messages:
maria: FYI spike in fncall schema rejects around 08:12 UTC. ~120 rejects in 10m mostly from the new invoice-parser toolchain.
kevin: ugh. any obvious pattern? model variant? payload size?
maria: mostly shape errors: extra fields + unexpected nulls. a chunk are from the mobile client (v1.3.2).
drew: current flow = strict-validate -> reject to client with 400 and log one event. we don't DLQ these today.
ellie: right now we route strict rejects to degen-route for hosted customers only, but toolcalls that fail schema just get immediate reject (no DLQ). that means ops + SRE can't replay to debug.
samir: replay would be huge for debugging, but raises PII/billing concerns. If we store payloads we need retention + redaction + opt-out.
maria: proposal: add a configurable dead-letter queue (DLQ) for fncall schema rejects. default off. On for enterprise customers or canary slices. include sampling + redaction.
kevin: what config surface do we expose in the Console? toggles + sampling %, maybe a retention slider?
drew: Suggestion: Console UI shows DLQ counter + last failure sample (redacted) and a replay button that replays to a sandboxed simulation runner. default sample = 0.1% globally, 100% for canary slice.
ellie: need to be careful: replayed payloads must never hit external tools or downstream webhooks in production. Replay should be internal-only or simulated.
samir: and billing: DLQ replays shouldn't generate billable function runs for customers unless they explicitly opt-in for replay; otherwise cost borne internally. We should flag replays as 'diagnostic' and not count towards token billing.
kevin: for telemetry, we want both aggregate rejects (count, rate, customers affected) and sampled raw payloads (redacted). Need tagging: customer_id, route_id, validator_reason.
maria: implementation sketch in config form:
```json
{"fncall": {"dead_letter": {"enabled": true, "sampling_pct": 0.5, "redact_rules": ["ssn", "credit_card"], "retention_days": 30, "replay_mode": "sandbox"}}}
```
drew: also add an alert rule: if DLQ volume > 1% of requests for 15m for any customer, auto-open a triage ticket and notify product oncall.
ellie: operationally we need to surface DLQ queue length in console and an export to S3 for long tail. Also a per-route toggle to send to DLQ vs immediate reject.
kevin: rollout plan: 1) feature flag in API (hidden) 2) enable for internal org + small enterprise pilot 3) enable sampling for 1% of host accounts 4) enable Console UI.
samir: privacy checklist: (a) redaction pipeline (b) user consent/contract language for enterprise customers (c) access controls in Console (RBAC) (d) audit logs for replay actions.
maria: question for infra: can we store DLQ items encrypted with per-customer keys (KMS)?
drew: yes, use envelope encryption with customer KMS key if provided, fallback to platform key. implement access gates in the console backend.
ellie: telemetry tag format proposal: `dlq:true|false`, `dlq_sample:true|false`, `validator:missing_field|type_mismatch|null_violation`, `route:invoice-parser-v2`. Keeps queries easy.
kevin: console UX: add a little badge on route listing like "DLQ: 17 (1.2%)" with hover showing sampling rate + retention. Clicking opens DLQ viewer with filters.
maria: security: limit replayers to a small role and log every replay as an auditable event with original requester id masked.
samir: we should also decide whether schema rejects are charged as attempts. currently rejects are free. If we let customers enable 100% DLQ + replay, we might cap replay budget or require purchase.
drew: agree — add quota config: `diagnostic_replay_budget_per_month` default 0 for free tier, configurable for enterprise.
ellie: small edge: streaming fncalls — partial streaming failures might need partial DLQ entries containing the last consistent state. spec that separately.
kevin: action items: Maria to write RFC draft, Drew to prototype DLQ storage + replay sandbox, Ellie to mock Console widgets, Samir to draft privacy/billing constraints.
maria: timeline: RFC this week, prototype next sprint, pilot in 3 weeks.
deploy-bot: canary deploy of fncall-validator v3 succeeded in eu-west-1 :rocket:
kevin: nice. thanks team. @maria ping me when RFC is up, I'll loop in product and legal.
maria: will do. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
